zh: 先连接 AI 并打开管事权
en: Connect AI and enable management first

zh: 今天先按熟悉的节奏过吧～
en: Let’s keep a familiar rhythm today.

zh: 好，你来安排，我就在旁边～
请根据眼前真实情况安排接下来一段。饿了优先张罗烧烤，雨天躲雨，夜里看星星或回家。
en: Plan the next part of today from actual facts. Feed hungry friends by barbecue; shelter in rain; stars or home at night.

zh: %s 砍了 %d 棵树，%d 木材已入库
东西还差一点，先等等吧。
en: We need a few more things. Let’s wait.

zh: 这会儿办不到，我换个安排吧。
en: That won’t work right now. Let me rethink it.

zh: 这段安排预计最多用到 %d 份材料。现在交给她们吗？
en: This plan may use up to %d materials. Go ahead?

zh: 好，你来安排，我就在旁边～
交给你啦，我去旁边看看～
en: Your turn! I’ll go have a look around.

zh: 我还没有管事权呢，要交给我吗？
en: May I have permission to manage everyone?
Wood is low. Chop some trees
Someone is hungry. Have a barbecue

zh: 保存后下次连接生效；已连接时请重连。
en: Saved changes apply on the next connection. Reconnect to apply now.
Mm… I drifted for a moment. I’m back.
